title: comdirect-fetch: Salden & Vermögen
description: Saldo-Verlauf je Konto und Vermögensentwicklung (Konten+Depots) – KONZEPT.md Abschnitt 6, Phase 1.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ab.recorded_at AS time, a.display_name AS metric, ab.balance AS value
FROM account_balances ab
JOIN accounts a ON a.id = ab.account_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(ab.recorded_at)
UNION ALL
SELECT ab.recorded_at AS time, 'Gesamt' AS metric, SUM(ab.balance) AS value
FROM account_balances ab
WHERE $__timeFilter(ab.recorded_at)
GROUP BY ab.recorded_at
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Vermögensentwicklung (Konten + Depots)
panels.description: Summe aller Kontosalden je Salden-Abruf, zzgl. des zu diesem Zeitpunkt jeweils zuletzt bekannten Gesamt-Depotwerts (Salden und Depotübersicht laufen auf unterschiedlichen Intervallen, siehe KONZEPT.md Abschnitt 3).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT t.time AS time, 'Vermögen gesamt' AS metric,
       t.balance_sum + COALESCE((
         SELECT SUM(ps.total_value)
         FROM portfolio_snapshots ps
         WHERE ps.recorded_at = (
           SELECT MAX(ps2.recorded_at) FROM portfolio_snapshots ps2 WHERE ps2.recorded_at <= t.time
         )
       ), 0) AS value
FROM (
  SELECT recorded_at AS time, SUM(balance) AS balance_sum
  FROM account_balances
  WHERE $__timeFilter(recorded_at)
  GROUP BY recorded_at
) t
ORDER BY t.time

SELECT SUM(balance) AS `Gesamtsaldo`
FROM account_balances
WHERE recorded_at = (SELECT MAX(recorded_at) FROM account_balances)

SELECT
  (SELECT SUM(balance) FROM account_balances WHERE recorded_at = (SELECT MAX(recorded_at) FROM account_balances))
  + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(total_value) FROM portfolio_snapshots WHERE recorded_at = (SELECT MAX(recorded_at) FROM portfolio_snapshots)), 0)
  AS `Vermoegen`
